items.title: Meet the Anzellans: Inside Imagineering R&D’s newest robotic characters
items.summary: Meet the Anzellans — Vilo Vele, Kado Bre'a, and Jibu Bre'a — the newest Audio-Animatronics character prototype from Walt Disney Imagineering R&D. Built with AWS, these autonomous characters don't run a fixed loop. They perceive guests in real time, decide how to respond, and act on their own, all within the story Imagineers designed.
items.creator: Ari Entin
